scope: 72个默认页面与236个声明状态的真实CUA网页截图、6项本轮二维美术及18张离线接触表；不是Godot游戏完成证明。

capture.performedBy: root代理的真实IAB截图会话；本文件生成者执行Pillow离线解码、哈希核验与接触表目视
capture.disclaimer: 真实网页UI原型截图，不是Godot正式游戏、3D实拍或历史图像证据。
capture.dimensionNote: 记录每张JPEG实际宽高；滚动条与长页可能使实际宽度为1424。文件修改时间单列，浏览器批次记录时间不当作每张截图的精确采集时刻。

unrecordedBrowserFields: 本轮browser-defaults/browser-states未记录badText或截图字节数；对应字段保留null。静态正文的undefined/NaN另由detail合同验收。
notCoveredByOfflineCheck: 未独立重放浏览器、控制台或点击流程
document无横向溢出不能排除局部overflow:hidden裁切
接触表只核查全局布局、色彩及异常，未逐字逐像素审查全部308张原图
无Godot、GPU或正式游戏玩法验收

visualReview.approach: 接触表总览及可疑页原图放大；最后重拍的货舱、任务日志、接舷已更新接触表并复核。
visualReview.findings: 接舷原先右侧局部裁切和双船构图已由root修复重拍；货舱与任务日志密度调整后操作区域完整。当前总览未发现新增明确阻断。
visualReview.limitations: 接触表缩略不能证明小字、对比度、所有控件边缘均逐像素合格；窄屏为72页几何检查加重点视觉抽检，另有9个状态几何检查，未纳入本桌面截图全量视觉承诺。

newArt.name: 港口暮色 · 首页
newArt.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: cinematic background painting for a flagship historical maritime PC game's main menu. Wide 16:9 landscape, no text, logos, UI, borders or watermarks. Early seventeenth century Fujian harbor, low eye level from a quiet stone quay, one authentic fully visible Chinese ocean-going Fujian junk with two dark rust-brown battened sails moored on the RIGHT half, hull wooden and weathered, not ornate fantasy. The LEFT 40 percent is a calm dark empty expanse of shaded harbor water and the shadowed edge of a wharf, deliberately clean negative space for menu typography. A few distant merchant junks recede into mist beyond the central opening, old tiled-roof waterfront and restrained coastal hill silhouettes, realistic rope and timber only where needed. Mood of a remembered historical epic, twilight before departure, hazy blue-gray atmospheric depth, delicate warm windows and thin muted amber rim light, deep ink teal shadows, aged dark umber timber. Tasteful traditional oil matte painting with translucent atmosphere and film still composition, no orange-teal blockbuster grading, no high-saturation tourist landscape, no giant rock towers, no swarms of tiny objects, no noisy sharpness, no artificial lensflare, not modern concept art. A quiet grand composition with a single unmistakable ship focal point; dignified, nostalgic and historically grounded.
newArt.review: 右侧整船与左侧安静留白适合首页菜单；降低饱和度与杂乱感。
newArt.method: Native ChatGPT ImageGen; no CLI fallback; unedited originals retained.

newArt.name: 平户港 · 仓房与码头
newArt.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: location illustration for a high-budget historical game port hub, 16:9 wide full scene, no interface/text/logos/watermark. Hirado harbor street in the 1620s, naturally observed early morning historical film still. Eye-level view from the shadow of an unadorned wooden merchant warehouse on the LEFT toward a small sunlit stone quay in the middle; the harbor and Chinese junk masts visible in pale sea mist on the RIGHT. Clean scene with only four small believable people, two Fujian traders carrying a silk bale, one Japanese porter beside a handcart, an older boatman seated near a coiled rope. Modest Japanese timber houses and tiled eaves, hanging plain woven cloth without writing. One weathered wooden doorway in foreground left, quiet wooden trestle with a barrel and a folded sheet of sailcloth; no rows of identical clutter. Muted stone, indigo cloth, umber timber, soft desaturated morning blue-green water, humid haze and filmic natural light. Restrained historical oil matte painting, historically plausible clothing and faces, atmospheric and nostalgic with careful negative space, rich material textures only around focal area, no fantasy, no modern vehicles, no tourist saturation or overdecorated buildings.
newArt.review: 仓房、交易与泊船三区清楚；作为历史情境候选，不宣称为1620年代真实城建复原。
